styles.webtoon: Korean webtoon manhwa illustration, clean confident black line art, cel shading with soft gradients, expressive emotional faces, bright natural colors, cinematic composition, original characters, not any real person. No text, no logos.
styles.clay: Claymation miniature diorama, handmade plasticine figures and props, tilt-shift photography with shallow depth of field, warm saturated colors, playful nostalgic Korean scene, soft studio light. No real brand logos.
